name: Sales overview
description: Sales of a sample electronics store in 2024-2025: revenue, orders, categories, regions and products, compared with the same period a year earlier.

widgets.body: Generated sales of a sample store, table sample.sales. Change the period, region and category on the left panel. Click a region bar or a category slice to open its details in place of the chart, and "Back" to return. Click a row in a table at the bottom to filter the dashboard by its category or region; set the filter back to All on the panel. The change is shown against the same period a year earlier.

widgets.title: Revenue
widgets.rawSql:
SELECT
    round(sumIf(total_amount, k_cur), 2) AS `Revenue`,
    if(round(sumIf(total_amount, k_prev), 2) = 0, NULL, round((toFloat64(round(sumIf(total_amount, k_cur), 2)) - toFloat64(round(sumIf(total_amount, k_prev), 2))) / toFloat64(round(sumIf(total_amount, k_prev), 2)) * 100, 1)) AS `Change, %`,
    'vs a year earlier' AS `Compared with`,
    (
        SELECT arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> toString(v), groupArray(t_revenue)), ',')
        FROM
        (
            SELECT toStartOfMonth(sale_date) AS t_month, round(sum(total_amount), 2) AS t_revenue
            FROM sample.sales
            WHERE sale_date BETWEEN toDate(:date_from) AND toDate(:date_to)
              AND (:region = 'All' OR region = :region)
              AND (:category = 'All' OR category = :category)
            GROUP BY t_month
            ORDER BY t_month
        )
    ) AS `Trend`
FROM
(
    SELECT
        total_amount,
        quantity,
        sale_date BETWEEN toDate(:date_from) AND toDate(:date_to) AS k_cur,
        sale_date BETWEEN subtractYears(toDate(:date_from), 1) AND subtractYears(toDate(:date_to), 1) AS k_prev
    FROM sample.sales
    WHERE (:region = 'All' OR region = :region)
      AND (:category = 'All' OR category = :category)
)

widgets.title: Orders
widgets.rawSql:
SELECT
    countIf(k_cur) AS `Orders`,
    if(countIf(k_prev) = 0, NULL, round((toFloat64(countIf(k_cur)) - toFloat64(countIf(k_prev))) / toFloat64(countIf(k_prev)) * 100, 1)) AS `Change, %`,
    'vs a year earlier' AS `Compared with`
FROM
(
    SELECT
        total_amount,
        quantity,
        sale_date BETWEEN toDate(:date_from) AND toDate(:date_to) AS k_cur,
        sale_date BETWEEN subtractYears(toDate(:date_from), 1) AND subtractYears(toDate(:date_to), 1) AS k_prev
    FROM sample.sales
    WHERE (:region = 'All' OR region = :region)
      AND (:category = 'All' OR category = :category)
)

widgets.title: Average order
widgets.rawSql:
SELECT
    round(sumIf(total_amount, k_cur) / greatest(countIf(k_cur), 1), 2) AS `Average order`,
    if(round(sumIf(total_amount, k_prev) / greatest(countIf(k_prev), 1), 2) = 0, NULL, round((toFloat64(round(sumIf(total_amount, k_cur) / greatest(countIf(k_cur), 1), 2)) - toFloat64(round(sumIf(total_amount, k_prev) / greatest(countIf(k_prev), 1), 2))) / toFloat64(round(sumIf(total_amount, k_prev) / greatest(countIf(k_prev), 1), 2)) * 100, 1)) AS `Change, %`,
    'vs a year earlier' AS `Compared with`
FROM
(
    SELECT
        total_amount,
        quantity,
        sale_date BETWEEN toDate(:date_from) AND toDate(:date_to) AS k_cur,
        sale_date BETWEEN subtractYears(toDate(:date_from), 1) AND subtractYears(toDate(:date_to), 1) AS k_prev
    FROM sample.sales
    WHERE (:region = 'All' OR region = :region)
      AND (:category = 'All' OR category = :category)
)

widgets.title: Units sold
widgets.rawSql:
SELECT
    sumIf(quantity, k_cur) AS `Units sold`,
    if(sumIf(quantity, k_prev) = 0, NULL, round((toFloat64(sumIf(quantity, k_cur)) - toFloat64(sumIf(quantity, k_prev))) / toFloat64(sumIf(quantity, k_prev)) * 100, 1)) AS `Change, %`,
    'vs a year earlier' AS `Compared with`
FROM
(
    SELECT
        total_amount,
        quantity,
        sale_date BETWEEN toDate(:date_from) AND toDate(:date_to) AS k_cur,
        sale_date BETWEEN subtractYears(toDate(:date_from), 1) AND subtractYears(toDate(:date_to), 1) AS k_prev
    FROM sample.sales
    WHERE (:region = 'All' OR region = :region)
      AND (:category = 'All' OR category = :category)
)

widgets.title: Revenue by month and category
widgets.rawSql:
SELECT
    formatDateTime(toStartOfMonth(sale_date), '%Y-%m') AS `Month`,
    round(sumIf(total_amount, category = 'Electronics'), 2) AS `Electronics`,
    round(sumIf(total_amount, category = 'Accessories'), 2) AS `Accessories`,
    round(sumIf(total_amount, category = 'Home'), 2) AS `Home`,
    round(sumIf(total_amount, category = 'Services'), 2) AS `Services`
FROM sample.sales
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN toDate(:date_from) AND toDate(:date_to)
  AND (:region = 'All' OR region = :region)
  AND (:category = 'All' OR category = :category)
GROUP BY `Month`
ORDER BY `Month`

widgets.title: Revenue by region
widgets.rawSql:
SELECT
    region AS `Region`,
    round(sum(total_amount), 2) AS `Revenue`
FROM sample.sales
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN toDate(:date_from) AND toDate(:date_to)
  AND (:region = 'All' OR region = :region)
  AND (:category = 'All' OR category = :category)
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY `Revenue`
widgets.chartConfig: {"type": "bar", "orientation": "horizontal", "categoryField": "Region", "valueFields": ["Revenue"], "showLegend": false, "yAxisFormat": "currency", "yAxisCurrency": "USD", "yAxisDecimals": 0, "description": "Click a region to see its revenue by month."}

widgets.title: Revenue by category
widgets.rawSql:
SELECT
    category AS `Category`,
    round(sum(total_amount), 2) AS `Revenue`
FROM sample.sales
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN toDate(:date_from) AND toDate(:date_to)
  AND (:region = 'All' OR region = :region)
  AND (:category = 'All' OR category = :category)
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY `Revenue` DESC
widgets.chartConfig: {"type": "pie", "donut": true, "categoryField": "Category", "valueFields": ["Revenue"], "showLegend": true, "legendPosition": "bottom", "description": "Click a category to see the revenue of its products."}

widgets.title: Top 10 products
widgets.rawSql:
SELECT
    product_name AS `Product`,
    category AS `Category`,
    count() AS `Orders`,
    sum(quantity) AS `Units`,
    round(sum(total_amount), 2) AS `Revenue`,
    round(avg(unit_price), 2) AS `Average price`
FROM sample.sales
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN toDate(:date_from) AND toDate(:date_to)
  AND (:region = 'All' OR region = :region)
  AND (:category = 'All' OR category = :category)
GROUP BY product_name, category
ORDER BY `Revenue` DESC
LIMIT 10
widgets.chartConfig: {"tableDensity": "compact", "clickParams": [{"column": "Category", "param": "category"}], "description": "Click a row to filter the dashboard by the category of the product."}

widgets.title: Regions
widgets.rawSql:
SELECT
    region AS `Region`,
    count() AS `Orders`,
    round(sum(total_amount), 2) AS `Revenue`,
    round(sum(total_amount) / (
        SELECT sum(total_amount)
        FROM sample.sales
        WHERE sale_date BETWEEN toDate(:date_from) AND toDate(:date_to)
          AND (:region = 'All' OR region = :region)
          AND (:category = 'All' OR category = :category)
    ) * 100, 1) AS `Share, %`
FROM sample.sales
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN toDate(:date_from) AND toDate(:date_to)
  AND (:region = 'All' OR region = :region)
  AND (:category = 'All' OR category = :category)
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY `Revenue` DESC
widgets.chartConfig: {"tableDensity": "compact", "clickParams": [{"column": "Region", "param": "region"}], "description": "Click a row to filter the dashboard by the region."}

  AND (:region = 'All' OR region = :region)

widgets.title: Revenue by product in the category
widgets.rawSql:
SELECT
    product_name AS `Product`,
    round(sum(total_amount), 2) AS `Revenue`
FROM sample.sales
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN toDate(:date_from) AND toDate(:date_to)
